packages.name: aws-cdk
packages.notes: AWS CDK command line (cdk synth, diff, deploy), Apache-2.0. Infrastructure tooling in infra/aws; never part of the application image. Separate lock file: docs/dependencies/register-infra-aws.json.

packages.name: aws-cdk-lib
packages.obligations: Keep the LICENSE and NOTICE files if the package is redistributed (it is not).
packages.notes: AWS CDK construct library, Apache-2.0 (its bundled dependencies are listed in the package; the NOTICE file ships with the package). Used only by infra/aws to produce CloudFormation templates; never part of the application image or the browser bundle.

packages.name: constructs
packages.notes: Construct programming model used by the CDK, Apache-2.0. infra/aws only.
